title: RHC Entity V2 Inventory
description: Owner-local inventory record (EV2-10 evolution of the EV2-03 foundation). A record still belongs to exactly one owning entity and records whether that entity's inventory is tracked at all (known/unknown/not_applicable). When known, it carries ordinary possessions as `entries` (each an explicit name + description + quantity) plus a structurally separate D&D `currency` object using exactly the official cp/sp/ep/gp/pp denominations. An entry's presence in the list is itself the established fact; entries carry no independent status field, because a listed item cannot itself be unknown or not_applicable the way a state or knowledge attribute can. Quantity is explicit (no implicit 1): zero quantity is absence and is never stored as an entry. Entries are unique under JSON item equality, so an equal name + description + quantity entry - including numerically equal quantities such as 1 and 1.0 - is a double-count. Currency is optional; when present it must be an object, so an explicit `currency: null` is invalid rather than a synonym for omission. Currency balances are non-negative integers and are never encoded as ordinary text items. Inventory truth remains owner-local: this is the same model for a Character inventory and a Party stash, not a separate stash subsystem. Individual persistent item identity/custody is deliberately not modelled here and is not inferred from this record; that is the later EV2-11 gate. This record also does not model custody transfer, equipped/attuned state, category/taxonomy, encumbrance, or provenance.
